# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"When the user selects a condenser type of Air Cooled (AC) or Evaporative Cooled (EC), the system must display the corresponding input fields, capture the entered parameters (including design ambient, ASHRAE summer design, tube/fin materials and sizes for AC, and bank ID, copies, EC model, wet bulb temperature for EC), record these parameters, and upon processing output a condenser and circuit‑level configuration ready for ECS calculation. For AC condensers, selecting Condenser Passes must present options AutoOdd, AutoEven, and numeric values 2 through 41 in increments of 1, and selecting Roof Type must present dark and light roof options with and without parapet/shrouding."

## Reviewer Findings

- F1 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The exact set of roof type option labels (beyond \"dark\" and \"light\") and how parapet/shrouding is represented is not defined." | "Obtain clarification on the full list of roof type option labels and the representation format for parapet/shrouding."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The catalog of valid EC Model values is referenced but not listed." | "Provide the complete catalog of permissible EC Model values."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Units for Design Ambient default are given as 95°F; conversion to °C is implied but not specified." | "Specify the exact conversion rule or value for the default Design Ambient when expressed in °C."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The acceptable range or validation rules for ASHRAE Summer Design, Copies of this Bank, and Wet Bulb Temperature are not provided." | "Define the valid ranges and any validation constraints for ASHRAE Summer Design, Copies of this Bank, and Wet Bulb Temperature."
- F5 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The format and content of the output \"condenser and circuit‑level configuration\" for ECS calculation are unspecified." | "Clarify the required structure, fields, and data format of the condenser and circuit‑level configuration output used for ECS calculation."
- F6 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The definition of \"coil geometry\" required for AC condenser recording is not detailed." | "Provide a detailed definition and required data elements for \"coil geometry\" when recording AC condenser parameters."
